gaps.name: DAIOS Autonomous Operating System Kernel
gaps.description: DAIOS (RFC-00D2) describes an autonomous decision substrate; implementation remains deferred behind experimental proof.

evidence.notes: Explicitly titled 'target architecture and sequencing note' with status: draft.

gaps.unresolved_questions: Will DAIOS supersede the existing TernaryOS C++ kernel or wrap it as an execution profile?

gaps.name: Physical Native Ternary Semiconductor Hardware
gaps.description: No physical native 3-state silicon exists in the repository. All execution runs on binary host CPUs or Verilog simulation.

evidence.notes: Hypothesis H01 notes current RTL uses two binary bits per trit and supplies no measured physical 3-state device advantage.

gaps.unresolved_questions: Physical device energy-delay metrics remain dependent on external third-party foundry fabrications.

gaps.name: TISC to LLVM / MLIR Production Compiler Backend
gaps.description: LLVM and MLIR translation bridges exist in lang/llvm and lang/mlir but are not integrated into the standard CLI release build.

evidence.notes: Code compiles under optional CMake flags but lacks comprehensive end-to-end JIT execution tests.

gaps.unresolved_questions: Should T81Lang prioritize direct bytecode emission or lower through MLIR dialects?

gaps.name: SCG-07 Finding F3 Complete Historical Causal Attribution
gaps.description: Finding F3 (T81Limb54::karatsuba) passes all current tests, but historical causal attribution for 299/300 SCG-06 failures remains incomplete.

evidence.notes: Receipt explicitly dispositioned as 'F3 CORRECT ON CURRENT BASELINE — historical causal attribution incomplete'.

gaps.unresolved_questions: Did F1 Booth table scaling fully account for intermediate Karatsuba carry failures on historical baselines?
